name: kaal-engineering
description: Engineering repository for KAAL. The distributable packages are under packages/.

scripts.test: npm run test:hosting && npm run test:kaal && npm run test:engineering
scripts.test:kaal: npm run test:workspaces && npm run test:acceptance
scripts.test:workspaces: npm run build -w kaal-hosting && node engineering/lanes/workspaces.mjs
scripts.test:acceptance: npm run build -w kaal-hosting && node engineering/lanes/acceptance.mjs
scripts.test:engineering: npm run build -w kaal-hosting && node --test engineering/github/lineage.test.ts engineering/change-isolation/check.test.mjs engineering/boundary.test.mjs engineering/delivery/pack.test.mjs
scripts.coverage: npm run build -w kaal-hosting && node engineering/coverage/measure.mjs
scripts.inventory: npm run build -w kaal-hosting && node engineering/inventory/measure.mjs
scripts.attribution: npm run build -w kaal-hosting -w kaal-core && node engineering/inventory/attribute.mjs
scripts.report: npm run build -w kaal-hosting -w kaal-core && node engineering/report/measure.mjs
